description: Implement the complete UI layer: Header with government banner and role/language switching, all portal components (Admission, ClassTeacher, Hostel, WhatsApp, Clerk, SuperAdmin, AiAssistant, PrdViewer, ImagePromptViewerModal), and the main App.tsx tab router. Full bilingual Marathi/English support, high-contrast navy/gold/emerald design, Lucide icons, and motion/react animations throughout.
steps: Create src/components/Header.tsx: Government banner with school name in Devanagari (शाश्वत माध्यमिक व उच्च माध्यमिक आश्रमशाळा पाथराज), Tribal Development Department branding, role switcher dropdown (Web Creator, Principal, Class Teacher, Clerk, Subject Teacher, Student/Parent), language toggle (EN/MR), UI Prompts trigger button. Use warm slate navy background, gold accents, Lucide icons (School, Users, Globe, Shield).

Create src/components/AdmissionPortal.tsx: Online application form for Std 1-10 (Marathi Medium) and Std 11-12 (Arts & Science streams). Fields: full name, standard, stream (if 11-12), caste category dropdown (Katkari, Thakar, Mahadev Koli, Gond, Other ST), Aadhaar number, mobile number, parent name. Aadhaar Face Auth verification simulation (animated button with success state). Auto-generated application ID (ASPS-2024-XXXXX). Status tracker showing Submitted -> Verified -> Approved -> Enrolled stages. Table of existing applications from mock data with search and filter.

Create src/components/ClassTeacherPortal.tsx: Standard selector (Std 1-12). Device IP check simulation (shows 'Whitelisted Desktop' or 'Read-Only Mobile' badge). Biometric daily attendance grid showing all students for selected standard. Mark Present/Absent/Late with animated toggles. Auto-parent WhatsApp alert simulation on absence marking. Attendance summary stats with percentage bars.

Create src/components/HostelPortal.tsx: Three tabs - Room Allotment, Mess Counter, Sick Bay. Room Allotment: visual grid of 520 beds across Boys Wing A, Boys Wing B, Girls Wing A, Girls Wing B with color coding (occupied/vacant/maintenance). Mess Counter: biometric fingerprint verification simulation for Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner meals with real-time count. Sick Bay: medical log entry form with student name, complaint, medication, WhatsApp parent notification toggle.

Create src/components/WhatsAppHub.tsx: Two sections - Dispatch Logs and AI Chatbot. Dispatch Logs: table of sent WhatsApp messages (admission confirmations, attendance alerts, health notices) with timestamp, recipient, message preview, delivery status. AI Chatbot: simulated chat interface for parent queries in Marathi about holidays, meal menus, exam schedules, tribal scholarships. Pre-loaded conversation examples.

Create src/components/ClerkPortal.tsx: Two sections - Staff Directory and PO Dispatch. Staff Directory: searchable table of 38+ staff with name, designation, contact, department. PO (Project Officer) Dispatch: official letter generator with recipient, subject, body fields, golden wax seal status indicator (Draft/Sealed/Dispatched), letter preview.

Create src/components/SuperAdminCenter.tsx: Two sections - Event Approvals and Audit Logs. Event Approvals: list of pending public notices/events with approve/reject buttons and comments. Audit Logs: security IP audit trail table showing user actions, IP addresses, timestamps, action types.

Create src/components/AiAssistant.tsx: 24/7 AI inquiry assistant UI. Chat interface with Gemini-powered responses (uses /api/ai-chat endpoint). Bilingual support - responds in whatever language the user types in. Quick action buttons for common queries: document readiness, eligibility check, application status, hostel info. Animated typing indicator.

Create src/components/PrdViewer.tsx: Embedded PRD/TAD/FSD documentation viewer. Tabbed interface showing system documentation from prdData.ts. Sections: System Overview, Module Specifications, Database Schema, API Endpoints, Role Matrix. Styled with code blocks and headings.

Create src/components/ImagePromptViewerModal.tsx: Modal overlay triggered from Header. Shows categorized image prompt specifications for visual assets. Categories: Campus Photos, Student Activities, Staff Portraits, Event Banners. Each prompt card with description, dimensions, style notes. Copy-to-clipboard button.

Update src/App.tsx: Full tab-based navigation using all components. Sidebar or top tab bar with icons for each module. Role-based visibility (hide certain tabs based on selected role). Bilingual tab labels. Smooth page transitions using motion/react. Context providers for language and role state.

Ensure all components use the design system: slate navy (#1e293b) backgrounds/headers, gold (#d4af37) for accents/highlights/buttons, emerald (#059669) for success/positive states, white/gray for content areas. Lucide icons on all interactive elements. motion/react for mount/unmount animations and hover effects.
Verify the complete application: npm run lint passes, npm run dev starts and serves all routes correctly.
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) passes with no type errors
npm run dev starts server on port 3000 successfully
Header shows school name in Devanagari with role switcher and language toggle
All 9 component tabs are navigable from the main App
AdmissionPortal shows application form and existing applications table
ClassTeacherPortal shows attendance grid for selected standard
HostelPortal shows bed grid, mess counter, and sick bay log
WhatsAppHub shows dispatch logs and AI chatbot interface
ClerkPortal shows staff directory and PO letter dispatch
SuperAdminCenter shows event approvals and audit logs
AiAssistant provides chat interface with bilingual responses
Role switching hides/shows appropriate portal tabs
Language toggle switches between English and Marathi labels
All components use the specified color scheme (navy, gold, emerald)
verification: Run npm run lint and confirm exit code 0
Run timeout 15 npm run dev and confirm server starts on port 3000
findings: All 11 components implemented with full interactivity. npm run lint passes with zero errors. Dev server starts on port 3000 and returns HTTP 200. Used motion/react for animations (not framer-motion). Tailwind v4 with @import works correctly. All components use mock data from mockData.ts. Role-based tab visibility and bilingual (EN/MR) switching both functional.
